_comment: Golden design constants. See golden/README.md. Do not hand-edit numbers without re-running the CLI.

launch.description: Real Taoglas EMPCB.SMAFSTJ.B.HT SMA + impedance-matched CPWG launch (gap 0.2512mm, ground inner edge 0.8512mm, feed 1.2mm, 6 stitch vias/side), topologies/launch.py TAOGLAS_CPWG -- the dual-mode default since 2026-09-02.

fab_tolerance_0p1mm.note: rounding every dimension to PCB resolution costs only 0.5dB

real_copper.note: Exterior ground planes as real copper (Boundaries.Conductivity surface impedance, 5.96e7 S/m, 17.5um). The ONLY trustworthy fabrication number: the thin dielectric/finish layers are unresolvable at this mesh density.

known_open_item: MEETS NEITHER the -16dB return-loss spec (-10.76dB) nor the 143.5MHz bandwidth target (316.6MHz), and this is a deliberate, measured trade rather than a tuning failure. Four 1-D scans on the assembled filter (w_iris; w_ext at two irises; y_wall) show bandwidth and return loss in DIRECT OPPOSITION on every geometry parameter: bandwidth reaches 145.6MHz exactly (FBW 4.94%) at w_iris=11mm but the match there collapses to -1.75dB. The user chose the good-match end (2026-09-03). A 30-eval local GP over a 5D +-2mm box CONFIRMED this geometry rather than improving it -- neighbouring probes came back worse and the 0.41dB apparent gain over the previous best is within the measured coarse-mesh noise floor.
fabrication_stack_not_modelled: Soldermask (20um), silkscreen (12um) and ENIG (4.5um) are EXCLUDED from the EM model: each is a full-board layer inside a mesh whose finest cell is 200um, so they mesh as extreme-aspect-ratio slivers (DOF count rises only ~3%). Measured damage scales monotonically with THINNESS -- mask -2.54dB, silkscreen -4.02dB, ENIG -7.19dB IL -- across two dielectrics and a conductor with unrelated material properties, which no physical mechanism produces. Resolving 4.5um needs ~1um cells, a ~1000x local refinement. The mask-over-feed decision therefore rests on engineering judgement (open it: a 20um eps_r=3.8 film across the 0.2512mm coplanar gap perturbs an already-weak launch), not on simulation.
